readme:
# Rightmove Property Scraper

Collect UK property listings from [Rightmove](https://www.rightmove.co.uk) search results, for sale or to rent. Give it a Rightmove search link, or a place name with a few filters, and get one structured row per listing: price, bedrooms, address, map position, agent details, photos and dates.

## What you can do with it

- Track asking prices and new listings in a town, postcode area or whole region.
- Compare sale and rental prices for the same area.
- Build lists of listings with the agent branch and phone number shown on the page.
- Feed a spreadsheet, dashboard or alert with fresh listings every day.

An empty input (`{}`) runs a small demo: homes for sale in London, 5 listings.

## Input

You can use search links, a location, or both in the same run.

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `startUrls` | string[] | Rightmove search result links for sale (`property-for-sale`) or to rent (`property-to-rent`). Set your filters on rightmove.co.uk first, then paste the link. | none |
| `location` | string | A town, area, station or postcode, for example `Manchester` or `SW1A 1AA`. A Rightmove location code such as `REGION^87490` also works. | none |
| `channel` | string | `BUY` or `RENT`. Applies to `location`. | `BUY` |
| `minPrice`, `maxPrice` | integer | Price range in GBP. For rent this is the price per month. Applies to `location`. | none |
| `minBedrooms`, `maxBedrooms` | integer | Bedroom range. Applies to `location`. | none |
| `radius` | string | Miles around the location: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 or 40. Applies to `location`. | none |
| `maxDaysSinceAdded` | integer | Only listings added in the last 1, 3, 7 or 14 days. Applies to `location`. | none |
| `maxResults` | integer | Maximum listings for each search link or location, 1 to 1000. | 50 (5 in the demo) |

Rightmove shows at most 42 pages of 24 listings (about 1000) for one search. To go beyond that, split the area into smaller searches or add price filters.

Example with search links:

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.rightmove.co.uk/property-for-sale/find.html?locationIdentifier=REGION%5E87490",
    "https://www.rightmove.co.uk/property-to-rent/find.html?locationIdentifier=REGION%5E87490"
  ],
  "maxResults": 60
}
```

Example with a location and filters:

```json
{
  "location": "Manchester",
  "channel": "RENT",
  "minPrice": 800,
  "maxPrice": 1800,
  "minBedrooms": 2,
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

Numbers may be given as text (`"100"`). A value that is not a number stops the run with a clear message in the run status.

## Output

One row per listing. Fields the page does not show are `null`.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `property_id`, `url` | Rightmove listing id and link |
| `channel` | `BUY` or `RENT` (commercial listings show for example `COMMERCIAL_BUY`) |
| `title`, `property_type` | Short description and type, for example `2 bedroom flat` and `Flat` |
| `display_address`, `country_code`, `latitude`, `longitude` | Address as shown and map position |
| `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `size`, `tenure` | Rooms, floor area text and tenure when shown |
| `price_amount`, `price_currency`, `price_frequency` | Price as a number, currency, and period for rentals |
| `price_display`, `price_qualifier`, `price_display_alt` | Price text as shown, qualifier such as "Guide Price", second price such as per week |
| `summary`, `key_features` | Listing text and feature bullets |
| `product_label`, `labels`, `tags` | Labels and badges on the listing card |
| `added_or_reduced`, `listing_update_type`, `listing_update_date` | Added or reduced text and the last change |
| `first_visible_date`, `let_available_date`, `updated_at` | Dates from the listing |
| `image_count`, `floorplan_count`, `virtual_tour_count` | Media counts |
| `main_image_url`, `image_urls`, `virtual_tours` | Photos shown on the results page and virtual tour links |
| `is_premium_listing`, `is_featured`, `is_new_home`, `is_build_to_rent`, `is_auction`, `is_student`, `is_commercial` | Listing flags |
| `online_viewings_available`, `fees_apply`, `fees_text` | Viewing and tenant fee information |
| `branch_id`, `branch_name`, `branch_display_name`, `agent_brand` | Agent branch |
| `agent_phone`, `agent_url`, `agent_logo_url`, `contact_url` | Agent contact details as published on the listing |
| `search_query`, `search_url`, `page_number` | Which search and results page found the listing |
| `data_source`, `scraped_at` | Always `website`, and the UTC collection time |

Results are de-duplicated by listing id within a run, also after a restart.

## Run outcomes

| Situation | Result |
|-----------|--------|
| Listings found | Run succeeds, status "Delivered N listings." |
| Search has no listings, or the location is not found | Run succeeds with 0 rows, nothing is charged, and the status says so |
| The charge limit you set is reached | Run succeeds and stops, status "Stopped at the max charge limit. N listings delivered." |
| Rightmove does not answer any request, or every attempt fails | Run fails with a status that says what happened. Retry later. |
| Input is not valid (for example `maxResults` is not a number) | Run fails at the start with the reason in the status |

## Pricing

Pay per event:

| Event | Name | Price |
|-------|------|-------|
| Run start, charged once with the first delivered rows | `actor-start` | $0.001 per run |
| One listing delivered | `rightmove-property-result` | $0.0008 per listing ($0.80 per 1,000) |

Nothing is charged when no listing is delivered. If you set a maximum total charge for the run, the run stops before a row would go over it. See the Pricing tab for current prices.

## FAQ

**Can I scrape both sale and rental listings?**
Yes. Use a `property-for-sale` link or `channel: BUY` for sales, and a `property-to-rent` link or `channel: RENT` for rentals. You can mix both in one run.

**How many listings can I get from one search?**
Rightmove stops a search at 42 pages of 24 listings. Use narrower areas, price bands or bedroom filters to cover a larger market.

**Why do some fields come back empty?**
Listings only show what the agent published. Rental rows have no tenure, sale rows have no price period, and many listings have no size or labels.

**How fresh is the data?**
Each run reads the live search pages, so rows reflect Rightmove at the time of the run. `scraped_at` records the time.

**Can I get the full listing description or all photos?**
This actor reads search result pages. It returns the summary, the key features and the photos shown there. It does not open each listing page.

**What happens if I stop or restart the run?**
Progress is saved after every batch. A restarted run continues from the saved page and does not repeat or re-charge rows already delivered.

## Data protection

The actor returns what Rightmove shows publicly on search result pages, including the agent branch name and the phone number the agent published. It does not log in and it does not collect personal data about buyers or tenants. You are responsible for using the data in line with Rightmove's terms and with data protection law such as UK GDPR, especially if you contact agents or combine the data with other sources.

## Support

Questions or a field you need? Open an issue on the Issues tab of this actor, or write to contact@nanoscrape.com.
